definitions.gloss: carrying through one's original intention; sticking to one's goal
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom: holding to the aim one set out with until it is achieved, without giving up or changing course.

examples.japanese: {初志貫徹|しょしかんてつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}ります→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll see it through to the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初志貫徹|しょしかんてつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧になった。
examples.english: She stuck to her original goal and became a doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{初志貫徹|しょしかんてつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れなかった→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times he failed, he never lost his resolve to see his original aim through.

notes:
Made of ⟦{初志|しょし}→初志：20082_shoshi⟧ "one's original aim" and {貫徹|かんてつ} "carrying through." A favorite of speeches, graduation messages and New Year's resolutions, and often written on calligraphy as a motto.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初志貫徹|しょしかんてつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to carry out one's original intention
- {初志貫徹|しょしかんてつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧: to persevere to the end
- ⟦{初志|しょし}→初志：20082_shoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: the same idea in verb form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}→有言実行：06148_yuugenjikkou⟧: doing what one has said one will do
